name: motion-walk-cycle
title: Walk Cycle
description: Nhân vật bước đều: thân nhún hai lần mỗi chu kỳ, tay chân đánh ngược pha nhau.

moworks.author: takayu

options.bob: units (5): low at contact, high at passing

credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ch-walk, written here): 1000 ms cycle = 2 steps (0.5 s each): body bobs |cos(phase)| x 5 px (low at contact, high at passing, twice per cycle); legs swing +-0.5 rad and arms -+0.6 rad on opposite-phase sines; loops. Params: step (0.5 s) · bob (5 px) · swing chân / tay (0.5 / 0.6 rad).
